description.value: You are unwilling to cause harm to a living creature in any way. You may not willingly harm another living being. You cannot take any action that deals HP damage or attribute damage to a living creature. You gain disadvantage on all attack rolls, even those against non-living targets or with weapons that don’t deal damage.
